name: Set Trap
description:
Choose one:

  • You drop and conceal one of your traps in an adjacent space. When a creature enters the trap's space, roll Stealth vs Awareness.

  • You throw a trap to an unoccupied space within short range. When a creature enters the trap's space, roll Craft vs Dexterity.

Either way, on a win, choose two of your trap effects (defined in the Trapper trait). On a loss, choose one Trap effect.
